product_metadata.title: Tangkula Wall Mount Bathroom Cabinet Wooden Medicine Cabinet Storage Organizer with 2-Doors and 1-Shelf Cottage Collection Wall Cabinet (Grey)
features: 【Multipurpose Usage】This bathroom cabinet is the best storage solution for small spaces. This wall-mounted bathroom cabinet can serve to store towels, shampoo and other toiletries in the bathroom. In the meantime, the storage cabinet can also be placed in the kitchen so that you can store plates, chopsticks, cups, etc.

【Adjustable Internal Shelf Heights】The minimalist style perfectly matches the living space, such as bathroom, kitchen and balcony and other rooms. Another key point to say is that the internal shelf can be adjusted to a suitable height within the 3" range to store items of different heights.

【Wall-mounted Design to Save Space】Due to its wall-mounted design, the medicine cabinet can be tightly fixed on the wall to make full use of the vertical space. The hanging storage cabinet is intended to save floor space greatly and increases space utilization for your apartment.

【Spacious Storage Space】The wall-mounted medicine cabinet with doors is spacious enough to store things. In addition to the two-door storage cabinet, the bathroom cabinet also features an open shelf, so that you can place the most commonly used items for easy access.

【Effortless Assembly】The attached package contains the necessary accessories and a detailed instruction, so this wall-mounted bathroom cabinet can be installed in a short time. [Warning: Safe painting is adopted when manufacturing. Leave it in ventilated place for a few days to get rid of its odor before installation.]
